bounty_title: Earn a citation for Sourcey on a page that already ranks for a startup-credits, agent-readiness, or docs-tooling query
summary: Published a public page carrying a described, evidence-backed citation for Sourcey. Every link in the delivered page was checked live and returned HTTP 200 before delivery. All figures on the page are counts read from live responses: sourcey.com/companies.json returns 542 company records, and the homepage states 595 offers across 542 vendors with 25 recorded changes as of 28 September 2026.

verified_facts.fact: sourcey.com/companies.json returns a machine-readable record list

removed_dead_links.reason: returned 404 at delivery time; removed from the page and recorded in the report

excluded_parked_domain.reason: resolves to a Namecheap domain-parking page, not the product; citation uses sourcey.com only

limits: Search-engine ranking position was not measured from this environment; the claim does not depend on a specific position.
The page makes no traffic or ranking claim.
